executiveAssessment.text:
Executive Conclusion. Bethesda Marriott reaches many monitored demand scenarios, but consideration consistency is the primary constraint.

What the Data Is Telling Us. Scenario Presence at 76.2% shows broad recognition across monitored traveler needs. AI Consideration at 42.9% shows that recognition does not consistently convert into selection in individual answers. The management problem is inclusion consistency — not awareness. Softness concentrates in Adventure; Celebration and Wellness remain stronger. When the hotel is absent, Hyatt Regency Bethesda most often appears (14 scenarios).

Why It Matters. Broad scenario reach without consistent appearance in AI answers means the hotel is known in the demand set but not reliably carried into traveler-facing answers. Management attention should start with consistency of representation, not with assuming the hotel needs an entirely new competitive set.

Where the Pattern Is Concentrated. Adventure is the softest Scenario Capture at 50.0%, while Celebration and Wellness show broader coverage. The inclusion issue is concentrated, not universal. Hyatt Regency Bethesda appears most often when the hotel is missing (14 scenarios) — use that pattern for source and fact checks, not as proof of cause. Reality Coverage is 20.0% (3 of 15 attributes). Start with gaps that matter operationally — beginning with 24-Hour Fitness Center.

What Management Should Focus On Now. Focus first on consistency of representation for Family Travel. Confirm priority sources present the same use cases and attributes that appear in scenarios where the hotel is absent, and close gaps that repeatedly coincide with cases where the hotel is missing.

What Not to Overreact To. No comparable prior official period is available — read these as current levels, not period-over-period change. Independent Positioning (#1 of 4; Portfolio AI Presence 42.1%) measures relative standing among loyalty peers. Strong peer rank does not mean consistent inclusion across the wider demand set.

What to Review Next. Compare high-presence versus low-consideration scenarios and inspect which sources and attributes appear when the hotel is missing. Use that evidence pack before changing channel strategy.
